sections.title: Breaking changes
entries:
#### solana_kit_surfpool: typed Surfpool cheatcodes

_Owner:_ [@ifiokjr](https://github.com/ifiokjr) · _Review:_ [PR #183](https://github.com/pina-rs/solana_kit/pull/183)

All 28 methods from the pinned Surfpool package are represented by public request
types and run through `solana_kit_client::Client`. Prepare local account state,
control the test clock, query confidential balances, profile transactions, and
upload caller-provided program bytes.

The client uses the transport, correlation IDs, admission limits, and byte and
depth budgets of the chosen host. It starts no executor, adds no retry loop, and
remains independent of the Surfpool server version.

sections.title: Breaking changes
entries:
#### solana_kit_system: all fourteen System instructions

_Owner:_ [@ifiokjr](https://github.com/ifiokjr) · _Review:_ [PR #183](https://github.com/pina-rs/solana_kit/pull/183)

Bounded data codecs, typed account builders, strict parsers, custom numeric
errors, and nonce account snapshots for the pinned System Program.

Every data type's `instruction` method constructs a fixed System invocation,
supplies Rent and RecentBlockhashes automatically, preserves ordered duplicate
accounts, and makes optional payer and signing-base accounts explicit. Seeded
builders validate UTF-8 byte length and base signatures while leaving PDA
derivation to the caller.

sections.title: Breaking changes
entries:
#### solana_kit_wallet: Wallet Standard and MWA

_Owner:_ [@ifiokjr](https://github.com/ifiokjr) · _Review:_ [PR #183](https://github.com/pina-rs/solana_kit/pull/183)

Portable Wallet Standard contracts for off-chain applications: typed feature
registries, authorization and signing capabilities, account selection, and
caller-owned cancellation without an executor.

The optional `mwa` feature adds portable association URIs, P-256 association
signing, ES256 JWS, HELLO negotiation, HKDF-SHA256 session keys, AES-128-GCM
frames, ordered sessions, JSON-RPC contracts, and SIWS messages. Returned
signatures remain raw bytes; verification stays the caller's responsibility.
